ja.html: 獅子吼 「――楽翁陣らくおうじん！」
ja.text:
獅子吼
「――楽翁陣らくおうじん！」

en.html:
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 Your summons, my lord?
獅子吼 Situation first. What is the state of His Highness Kuniuji's protection?
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 Three armored warriors of his personal retinue appear to be guarding him.
獅子吼 Three... Insufficient reassurance. I shall take Nabuse and go to him myself, then.
獅子吼 Send one of your units round the rear to prepare an escape as well. If the situation does not improve satisfactorily, His Highness must first withdraw from the mansion.
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 To move our lord on account of so small a hostile force. A humiliation, my lord.
獅子吼 One more matter for which I must cut open my belly in apology, once the great ambition is achieved. That is all. His Highness's safety cannot be traded for it.
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 As you command. And ourselves?
獅子吼 Kanae is following me. Kill her.
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 —
獅子吼 Ordinary soldiers cannot be relied upon. The mere sound of the three characters of Kanae's name, and their knees give way...
獅子吼 Ten years, it seems, have done nothing to remove their dread of the disinherited princess.
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 It is as one might expect.
獅子吼 You fellows, at least, will not disgrace yourselves?
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 We fear that princess no less. But expendable stones are what we have been from the beginning.
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 There is nothing for us to spare. We shall seek to take her life at the cost of our own.
獅子吼 Good. Go!
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 Yes, my lord!
en.text:
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
Your summons, my lord?


獅子吼
Situation first. What is the state of His Highness Kuniuji's protection?




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
Three armored warriors of his personal retinue appear to be guarding him.


獅子吼
Three... Insufficient reassurance. I shall take Nabuse and go to him myself, then.


獅子吼
Send one of your units round the rear to prepare an escape as well. If the situation does not improve satisfactorily, His Highness must first withdraw from the mansion.




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
To move our lord on account of so small a hostile force. A humiliation, my lord.


獅子吼
One more matter for which I must cut open my belly in apology, once the great ambition is achieved. That is all. His Highness's safety cannot be traded for it.




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
As you command. And ourselves?


獅子吼
Kanae is following me. Kill her.




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
—


獅子吼
Ordinary soldiers cannot be relied upon. The mere sound of the three characters of Kanae's name, and their knees give way...


獅子吼
Ten years, it seems, have done nothing to remove their dread of the disinherited princess.




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
It is as one might expect.


獅子吼
You fellows, at least, will not disgrace yourselves?




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
We fear that princess no less. But expendable stones are what we have been from the beginning.


ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
There is nothing for us to spare. We shall seek to take her life at the cost of our own.


獅子吼
Good. Go!




ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣
Yes, my lord!

ja.html:
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「お召しの儀は」
獅子吼 「まず現状だ。 　邦氏殿下のご身辺はどうなっている？」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「近習の武者三騎が固めておる様子」
獅子吼 「三騎……心許ない。 　ならばそちらには俺が銘伏なぶせを連れて向かう」
獅子吼 「陣の一組を裏へ回して、脱出の手筈も整え させておけ。 　状勢の回復が思わしからぬようであれば、 殿下にはひとまず屋敷からご避難頂く」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「小勢に追われて主君を動かすと仰せか。 　恥辱でござるな」
獅子吼 「大望成った後、我が腹を捌いて詫びるべき 事柄がまた一つ増えるというだけの話だ。 　殿下の御身には代えられん」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「御意。 　して、我らは？」
獅子吼 「俺の後を香奈枝が追っている。 　殺せ」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「――」
獅子吼 「尋常の兵どもでは当てにならん。 　あやつらは香奈枝の三字を耳にするだけで 腰が砕ける……」
獅子吼 「廃嫡姫への畏怖は十年の時を経ても拭われ なかったらしい」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「さもあろうかと」
獅子吼 「貴様らはよもや醜態を見せまいな？」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「あの姫を恐るるは我らとて同じ。 　されど我らは元より捨石の者」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「惜しむべき何物もござらねば、差し違えに 挑んで討ち果たし申そう」
獅子吼 「良し。行け！」
ｅｔｃ／楽翁陣 「はッ」
